instrument: Denial of NorthPoint land development application, Project Hazelnut (Nov 2025)
summary: The Board of Supervisors unanimously rejected NorthPoint's land development application for a 15-building data center campus on about 1,280 acres near the Humboldt Industrial Park, after objections that the project should first have gone to the zoning hearing board as a special exception.

source.citation: Times Leader; Fox 56; Center Square; Food & Water Watch; Penn Capital-Star (Nov 2025-Sept 2026)

notes: In Sept 2026 NorthPoint mailed households an offer tied to approval: a $165M package including a $45M resident grant fund ($10,000 per eligible household), a $15M community fund and $105M to the township (~$7M/yr for 15 years). An offer, not an instrument.
